description.zh:
配置内容，可以选择传入：

- 配置内容文本。格式请参见[驱动与设备信息配置](~~120906~~)内容。
- 存储配置文件的阿里云对象存储（OSS）地址。
description.en:
The configuration content. You can pass one of the following:  

- The configuration text. For the required format, see [Driver and Device Information Configuration](~~120906~~).  
- The Object Storage Service (OSS) URL where the configuration file is stored.

description.zh: 配置文件格式。取值有KV（键值对配置）、JSON（JSON格式）、FILE（配置文件）。
description.en: The file format of the configuration. Valid values include KV (key-value pair configuration), JSON (JSON format), and FILE (configuration file).

description.zh: 配置的关键字。在有多个配置的情况下，用于区分配置。
description.en: The keyword of the configuration. It is used to distinguish between configurations when multiple configurations exist.

description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target driver name on the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh:
边缘实例的ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**边缘实例**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by moving the mouse pointer over the target edge instance name on the **Edge Instances** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).  

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain it.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not pass this parameter for public instances. For Enterprise instances, you must pass this parameter.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。
> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to call this API.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun iot set-edge-instance-driver-configs --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --driver-id 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --configs Format=JSON Content=test_:123 Key=key1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun iot SetEdgeInstanceDriverConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --Configs.1.Content 'test_:123' --DriverId 021d154d2a2f4dd7a489773d9e040000 --Configs.1.Key key1 --IotInstanceId 'iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000' --InstanceId F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --Configs.1.Format JSON
